newsitem.title: INDIA: India export credit cap at 13 pct up to 90 days.
newsitem.headline: India export credit cap at 13 pct up to 90 days.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Tuesday it kept the 13.0 percent cap on export credit of up to 90 days, but gave banks the option to offer lower rates.

"It has been decided that effective April 16, 1997, the interest rates on post-shipment rupee export credit up to 90 days be changed from the existing 13.0 percent per annum to not exceeding 13.0 percent," the central bank said in its credit policy for the first six months of 1997/98 (April-March).
This was being done to give "operational freedom" to banks and also of some banks' "willingness" to lower the rates if proceeds are realised in shorter periods, the RBI said.
Interest rate on export credit beyond 90 days and up to six months from the date of shipment remain unchanged at 15.0 percent, it added.
